On the Pitch

How to Watch: Washington Spirit vs. Kansas City Current in the 2026 NWSL Championship

Find out where to watch and stream the Championship in Washington, D.C.
November 20, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:16
Instaread

The 2026 NWSL Championship is set with two star-studded teams facing off this weekend in the nation’s capital. The No. 3 seed Washington Spirit will play at home at Audi Field in Washington, D.C. against No. 4 seed Kansas City Current on Saturday, Nov. 21 at 8 p.m. ET.

  • MORE: EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT THE 2026 NWSL PLAYOFFS

The Spirit dominated the Portland Thorns, 4-1, in the Quarterfinal before earning a come-from-behind win against the Utah Royals in the Semifinal to return to the championship match for the third straight season. Meanwhile, a penalty kick in extra time of the Quarterfinal against Angel City FC sent the Current to the Semifinal, where an 89th minute game-winner helped Kansas City take down No. 1 seed Gotham FC.

The Championship will air on Paramount+ and CBS. Here’s how to catch all the action live:

HOW TO WATCH THE NWSL CHAMPIONSHIP ON TV

The Championship will be broadcast live on CBS with English commentary. Pregame coverage begins at 7:30 p.m. ET.

HOW TO STREAM THE NWSL CHAMPIONSHIP

Fans can stream the Championship on Paramount+ with English commentary.

FOLLOW THE NWSL ON SOCIAL MEDIA

In addition to broadcast information, fans can stay up to date by following the NWSL on the NWSL website, as well as on Instagram, X/Twitter and Facebook.

CHAMPIONSHIP MATCH UP NEXT 🏆🔜 More info at the link in our bio. // NWSL Championship pres. by Google Pixel https://t.co/TJnpi6lhni

— National Women’s Soccer League (@NWSL) November 15, 2026
